rationale_per_step.research-head-parse-comments: The corpus that landed this run found two defects. One is fixed; the other is that the parser reads commented-out tags, so a template placeholder becomes a company's stored name. The corpus now exists to measure the fix, which is the cheapest this item will ever be.

category_mix: maintenance. Four of the last five runs paid down debt on the reader-facing surfaces; this one is a correctness bug in the enrichment path, found by evidence rather than by reading, and the page it needs is a fixture away.
